# aap_eda_event_stream (Data Source)

Get EDA event stream datasource

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "aap_eda_event_stream" "example-id" {
  id = "1"
}

data "aap_eda_event_stream" "example-name" {
  name = "Default"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The ID of the EDA event stream. Either specify `id` or `name` but not both.
- `name` (String) The name of the EDA event stream. Either specify `id` or `name` but not both.

### Read-Only

- `additional_data_headers` (String) The additional http headers which will be added to the event data. The headers are comma delimited.
- `eda_credential_id` (Number) The EDA credential ID associated with the EDA Event Stream.
- `event_stream_type` (String) The event stream type for the EDA Event Stream based on credential type.
- `organization_id` (Number) The organization ID for the EDA Event Stream.
- `test_mode` (Boolean) Enable test mode.
- `url` (String) The url for the EDA Event Stream.
- `uuid` (String) The uuid for the EDA Event Stream.
